# Priscilla Grant

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v3 c1 P21](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0021)</sub>
- **Role:** College student and former teacher  <sub>[v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v3 c1 P21](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0021)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Pris  <sub>[v3 c4 P15](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0015)</sub>

## Appearance

Priscilla is a tall, pale, and spiritual-looking maiden. She has fair, golden hair.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v3 c4 P6](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0006), [v3 c4 P16](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0016)_

## Personality

Priscilla is full of fun, mischief, and pranks, despite her spiritual appearance. She possesses an unselfish admiration for the gifts and graces of her friends, and holds high ideals regarding the beauty and love found in the world. She also has a great love for nature and a sense of humour.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c36 P1](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0001), [v3 c6 P15](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0015), [v3 c9 P23](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0023)_

## Traits

- Full of mischief and pranks  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- Unselfish  <sub>[v1 c36 P1](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0001)</sub>

- Classics scholar  <sub>[v1 c35 P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005)</sub>
- Story writing  <sub>[v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020)</sub>

## Goals

- To earn a B.A. degree at Redmond College  <sub>[v3 c1 P21](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0021), [v3 c9 P29](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0029)</sub>

## History

Priscilla Grant originally met Anne Shirley while attending Queen's Academy, where she joined Anne's story club. After graduating, she taught school at Carmody for two years before entering Redmond College in Kingsport alongside Anne. The two boarded together at Thirty-Eight St. John's Street and later moved into Patty's Place on Spofford Avenue along with Philippa Gordon, Stella Maynard, and Aunt Jamesina. At Redmond, Priscilla pursued a course in Classics and graduated with Honors. After graduation, she planned to spend time teaching, but retained a lifelong friendship with her college companions.

_Sources: [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v3 c1 P21](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0021), [v3 c3 P17](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0017), [v3 c9 P12](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0012), [v3 c10 P18](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0018), [v3 c35 P5](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0005), [v3 c36 P23](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0023), [v3 c37 P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029)_
